ns2:section.sectionText: A select program designed to prepare students for a successful career in pricing; course incorporates peer mentorship, guest lectures by industry professionals, case studies and competitions, company visits and summer internship opportunities. Students will normally apply during the spring semester of their sophomore year and, if accepted, participate during their junior and senior years. Course will not satisfy Business Administration major requirements. Admission by application only.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
